title: Multi-symbol dashboard indicator panel EA (manual buy/sell buttons)
entry_long: manual click of on-chart buy button; dashboard shows EMA5>EMA13 and RSI>60 as up-signal per symbol
entry_short: manual click of on-chart sell button; dashboard shows EMA5<EMA13 and RSI<40 as down-signal per symbol
buildon_idea: tooling/dashboard only, no automated entry-exit logic; could wire dashboard signals to auto-execution as a next step
novelty_note: multi-symbol (10-pair) dashboard scanner with manual trade buttons, not itself a trading strategy - low novelty as tool

title: Close-first-order-and-profitable-orders EA: EMA100 trend distance entry with grid recovery
entry_long: price below EMA100 by more than ema_distance(60 pips default); one order per bar
entry_short: price above EMA100 by more than ema_distance(60 pips default); one order per bar
exit: close first order plus all currently-profitable orders when summed profit_all > close_money($3 default); no SL/TP on individual orders
family: trend-distance entry with grid-recovery order management
buildon_idea: already capped at 15 orders; flat-lot test first to confirm entry edge; try linear-add or log lot law instead of fixed 0.1 lot per add, or switch market entries to pending limit orders to avoid spread
novelty_note: reusable close-first+close-profitable order-management pattern via for-loop profit aggregation across up to 15 positions - technique has more value than the entry signal itself

title: Close-first-order-and-profitable-orders EA revise 3: RSI+doji entry with 30-order grid cap
timeframe: 1-5min (stated); period param adjustable for higher TF
entry_long: RSI(7)<30 (oversold) and prior candle is bullish doji (lower wick > upper wick, upper wick > body)
entry_short: RSI(7)>65 (overbought) and prior candle is bearish doji (upper wick > lower wick, upper wick > body)
exit: close first order plus all profitable orders when profit_all > close_money($30 default); no SL/TP on individual orders
escalation_cap: 30 orders (Max Order, raised from 15 in prior revise)
family: rsi-extreme + doji entry with grid recovery
buildon_idea: already capped at 30 orders; flat-lot test first; try linear-add or log lot law instead of fixed 0.1 lot grid-add at 15-pip spacing
novelty_note: doji detection via 3-condition wick/body comparison combined with RSI extremes; common building blocks, low-to-moderate novelty; author reports 140%+/2yr backtest on EURUSD but unvalidated by lab

title: Close-first-order-and-profitable-orders EA revise 2: EMA100-distance entry with engulfing-confirmed grid recovery
entry_long: price below EMA100 by more than ema_distance(25 pips) then EMA3 crosses above EMA8 (reversal confirmation)
entry_short: price above EMA100 by more than ema_distance(25 pips) then EMA3 crosses below EMA8
exit: close first order plus profitable orders when profit_all (first-order loss + recovered gains) > cross_money($30 default); no SL/TP on individual orders
lot_law: grid-add, recovery adds gated by bullish/bearish engulfing pattern confirmation at 15-pip grid spacing
family: ema-distance+cross entry with engulfing-gated grid recovery
buildon_idea: already capped at 15 orders; flat-lot test first; extend symbol/TF coverage; try linear/log lot law on the recovery adds
novelty_note: uses bullish/bearish engulfing as a selectivity filter before adding grid orders, rather than blind distance-triggered add - moderate novelty improvement over naive grid

title: Close-first-order-and-profitable-orders EA revise 4: RSI+doji entry with position-count-scaled linear lot recovery
entry_long: RSI(7)<30 and prior candle bullish doji
entry_short: RSI(7)>70 and prior candle bearish doji
exit: close first order plus profitable orders when profit_all > close_money($5 default); no SL/TP on individual orders
lot_law: linear-add (recovery-order lot size = current open-position count in that direction * 0.01, e.g. 3 open orders -> 0.03 lot next add)
escalation_cap: 30 orders max; lot size explicitly volume-capped at 0.3 via volume_upper_limit
family: rsi+doji entry with count-scaled linear-add lot recovery
buildon_idea: already implements linear-add lot law with explicit volume cap - directly matches the doctrine's preferred build-on target; compare against flat-lot baseline, extend to more symbols/TF
novelty_note: concrete worked example of linear position-count-scaled lot sizing (lot=count*0.01) as an alternative to fixed-volume grid add - useful reference implementation

title: EMA-cross entry with equity-percentage-tiered lot sizing
entry_long: EMA(fast=5) crosses above EMA(slow=12) at candle[3], distance between them > check_distance(3 pips)
entry_short: EMA(fast=5) crosses below EMA(slow=12) at candle[3], distance > 3 pips
exit: close all buy or all sell orders when unrealized profit sum > close_TP(20 pips, as-position aggregate); no SL
lot_law: fixed, tiered by account equity: 0.1 lot if equity>90% of balance, 0.2 lot if 80-90%, 0.4 lot if 70-80%, 0.8 lot if equity<70% of balance; grid re-entry every 40 pips within a direction
escalation_cap: unspecified (no explicit Max Order constant found for this variant; lot escalates as equity/balance ratio worsens)
family: ema-cross entry with equity-drawdown-inverse lot sizing
buildon_idea: current logic increases lot size as equity falls relative to balance (adds risk into drawdown) - buildon: invert to reduce lot as equity falls instead, or add an explicit hard order-count cap; author's own 2x-lot test doubled DD from 27% to 57%, confirming lot escalation is the main risk lever
novelty_note: equity% based lot-tier money management block is a distinct reusable risk-sizing module worth cataloging separately from the entry logic

title: Custom-sequence (weighted multiplier) money management with reversal candlestick entry
entry_long: prior candle (ID2) bearish with body_size>=20 pips, then reversal candle (ID1) bullish with body_size>=10 pips
entry_short: prior candle (ID2) bullish with body_size>=20 pips, then reversal candle (ID1) bearish with body_size>=10 pips
exit: fixed SL 50 pips / TP 100 pips per individual order
lot_law: martingale (FX Dreema built-in Custom Sequence block: on-loss lot multiplier sequence 2,3,5,8,13,21,33,53,85,136,218,349,558,839 x base lot, wraps back to step 1 after 14 steps; on-profit sequence resets multiplier to 1x base after any win)
escalation_cap: finite 14-step sequence then wraps to step 1; each order also carries its own fixed 50-pip SL
family: reversal-candlestick entry with custom-sequence martingale money management
buildon_idea: sequence is finite and each trade has its own SL (not classic uncapped martingale), but multiplier reaches 839x base lot at worst case - buildon: cap the sequence at a lower step (e.g. 3-5x max) to bound worst-case drawdown, and flat-lot test the entry signal in isolation first
novelty_note: demonstrates FX Dreema's Custom Sequence MM block with an arbitrary weighted multiplier list (not simple doubling) - reusable money-management module distinct from standard martingale

title: Liquidity and inducement trap: 3-candle momentum-trap fade with dynamic TP/SL lines
timeframe: unspecified (pip-adjustment constant tuned for EUR pairs)
entry_long: 3 consecutive bearish candles (ID1-ID3) with summed body size > trap_start(45 pips) draws a TP line just below the ID3 candle's open; on subsequent reversal signal (ID3 bearish, ID2/ID1 bullish, min 1-pip body) opens buy at 5-pip grid spacing
entry_short: 3 consecutive bullish candles with summed body size > 45 pips draws TP line just above ID3 open; on bearish reversal signal opens sell at 5-pip grid spacing
exit: take-profit when price crosses the drawn trap line (B_Tab/S_Tab, closes all orders in that direction); stop-loss when price crosses a fixed-distance line (0.004 price units, ~40 pips for EUR) from the first order's open price
lot_law: grid-add (fixed 0.1 lot per re-entry on repeated reversal signals within the trap zone, 5-pip spacing)
escalation_cap: none stated in transcript (no explicit Max Order constant found for repeated grid re-entries within the trap window)
family: liquidity-trap fade (smart-money-concept style) with grid re-entry
buildon_idea: add an explicit max-order cap to the grid re-entry loop (currently unbounded in the transcript); the 0.001/0.004 pip-adjustment constants are EUR-specific and need re-tuning per instrument before testing other symbols
novelty_note: liquidity/inducement-trap fade concept (SMC-style) with a dynamically drawn TP line off the breakout candle and a separate fixed-distance SL line - distinctive entry/exit construction, moderate novelty; author reports >100%/1yr on EURUSD 2022 but unvalidated by lab
